title: Task Convergent Flow Matching for Generative Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2611.22609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Successful manipulation requires the manipulated objects to progress toward a desired task outcome. Generative policies can produce plausible robot motions without ensuring this progress, allowing successive action chunks to stall or undo earlier changes to the scene. We introduce a task-centric inference-time refinement framework for flow matching policies that evaluates candidate action chunks through parallel physics-based rollouts and searches for motions satisfying sufficient conditions for task convergence. Task-level performance funnels bound temporary regressions while requiring net progress over each chunk. We establish sufficient conditions under which repeated funnel satisfaction yields convergence throughout execution, and use interval-wise Lipschitz bounds to verify continuous-time funnel satisfaction from sampled rollouts. translated_title: 面向生成式机器人技术的任务收敛流匹配
translated_abstract: 成功的操作要求被操作对象朝着期望的任务结果不断推进。生成式策略能够产生看似合理的机器人运动，却无法保证这种推进，导致连续的动作片段可能出现停滞或撤销先前对场景的更改。我们提出了一种以任务为中心的推理时优化框架，用于流匹配策略，该框架通过并行的基于物理的仿真推演来评估候选动作片段，并搜索满足任务收敛充分条件的运动。任务级性能漏斗在限制临时倒退的同时，要求每个动作片段实现净进展。我们建立了重复满足漏斗条件可在整个执行过程中产生收敛的充分条件，并使用逐区间Lipschitz界从采样的仿真推演中验证连续时间上的漏斗满足性。为了适应接触丰富的混合动力学，我们使用无导数方法来优化流的源种子……
tldr: 提出了一种以任务为中心的推理时优化框架，通过并行物理仿真推演和任务级性能漏斗对流匹配策略进行优化，确保机器人操作动作持续收敛于期望的任务目标。
en_tdlr: A task-centric inference-time refinement framework for flow matching policies that uses parallel physics-based rollouts and task-level performance funnels to guarantee that robot manipulation actions progressively converge toward the desired task outcome.
